hook: Once this booster is lit, nothing can turn it off
narration: Once this rocket booster is lit, nothing can turn it off.
It was built for NASA's Moon rocket, and fired lying on its side in the Utah desert.
Its fuel is solid, packed inside the casing, and it burns until all of it is gone.
Two of these boosters give the rocket more than seventy five percent of its thrust.
Engineers fired this one to test new materials for future boosters.
outcome: It burned for the full two minutes, right there on the test stand.
title: Moon rocket booster fired on its side
description:
NASA and Northrop Grumman fired a Space Launch System solid rocket booster for two minutes at the T-97 test facility in Promontory, Utah, Sept. 2, 2020, to evaluate new materials for future boosters.
